title: The Bone Harp
text: A harp made of bone stands in the barrow's heart, strung with long grey hair. Its frame is the curve of a spine. As the living come near it begins to play itself, a slow sweet tune that makes every one of you think of home.

options.label: Stand and listen to it play, and let it remind you of home.

outcomes.text: It plays a lament that eases the heart. For a little while, the dark feels like home.
Its lament wakes the dead. They rise homesick and angry, looking for someone to blame.

options.label: The steadiest hand plays it, careful to choose the right song.

outcomes.text: The wisest plays a song of binding, slow and low. The barrow sleeps; the hair on the strings goes still.

options.label: Break it. Nothing strung with hair should be allowed to sing.

outcomes.text: As the spine snaps, someone screams in the dark, though none of you. A shard of it comes away as hard and old as dragon's bone.
